title: Sharks, rays and relatives: name the family
intro: Name the taxonomic family of each animal (sharks, rays and relatives).

questions.prompt: To which family does the bowmouth guitarfish (Rhina ancylostoma) belong?
questions.explain: The bowmouth guitarfish (Rhina ancylostoma) belongs to the family Rhinidae, order Rhiniformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Grey reef shark (Carcharhinus amblyrhynchos) belong?
questions.explain: The Grey reef shark (Carcharhinus amblyrhynchos) belongs to the family Carcharhinidae, order Carcharhiniformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Megamouth shark (Megachasma pelagios) belong?
questions.explain: The Megamouth shark (Megachasma pelagios) belongs to the family Megachasmidae, order Lamniformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Angel Shark (Squatina squatina) belong?
questions.explain: The Angel Shark (Squatina squatina) belongs to the family Squatinidae, order Squatiniformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the velvet belly lanternshark (Etmopterus spinax) belong?
questions.explain: The velvet belly lanternshark (Etmopterus spinax) belongs to the family Etmopteridae, order Squaliformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Rabbitfish (Chimaera monstrosa) belong?
questions.explain: The Rabbitfish (Chimaera monstrosa) belongs to the family Chimaeridae, order Chimaeriformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Lesser Spotted Dogfish (Scyliorhinus canicula) belong?
questions.explain: The Lesser Spotted Dogfish (Scyliorhinus canicula) belongs to the family Scyliorhinidae, order Carcharhiniformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the horn shark (Heterodontus francisci) belong?
questions.explain: The horn shark (Heterodontus francisci) belongs to the family Heterodontidae, order Heterodontiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the spiny dogfish shark (Squalus acanthias) belong?
questions.explain: The spiny dogfish shark (Squalus acanthias) belongs to the family Squalidae, order Squaliformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the crocodile shark (Pseudocarcharias kamoharai) belong?
questions.explain: The crocodile shark (Pseudocarcharias kamoharai) belongs to the family Pseudocarchariidae, order Lamniformes.
